name: lioralabs
description: Liora Labs Claude Code plugins: cliban (agent-first kanban CLI), cliban-flow (its scoping and execution workflow), cook (build-system skills), codegraph (code-navigation discipline), ppu-toys (native PPU demo authoring), and game-bible (building games with agents under human control)

plugins.name: cliban
plugins.description: Drive the cliban kanban board from the CLI: issue and bug tracking, project status, ticket creation, milestones, progressive project memory, the Linear import/push bridge (import --mine, sync, living progress comments, push-on-move), and per-repo setup that binds a repo to its board. Live board state is injected into every session in a bound repo

plugins.name: cliban-flow
plugins.description: The cliban-native feature workflow: explore-feature diverges a rough idea into an approved design, scope-milestone grills it closed and publishes tracer-bullet tickets with native blocking edges (on a milestone when the work needs more than one slice), complete-issue plans and executes a single ticket test-first, and complete-milestone orchestrates a whole milestone in dependency waves with one agent per ticket. Carries the workflow contract for where specs, plans, and lessons live. Requires the cliban plugin

plugins.name: cook
plugins.description: Skills for the cook build system: using cook, authoring Cookfiles, and authoring cook modules

plugins.name: ppu-toys
plugins.description: Create uploadable ppu.toys demos with the standalone ppu CLI: Lua register control, Mode 7, HDMA, native rendering, and checks

plugins.name: codegraph
plugins.description: Discipline layer for codegraph (colbymchenry/codegraph): a routing ladder that sends agents to the knowledge graph for orientation, tracing, and blast radius — and to grep when grep honestly wins

plugins.name: waytchme
plugins.description: Edit a WaytchMe take as Murphy: obey spoken directives, cut fluff, caption, review before rendering

plugins.name: game-bible
plugins.description: House rules for building games with agents while keeping a human in control: KDL content and a CSS dialect for look (the tweak map: nothing tweakable hides in source), a vocabulary built before content, functional core / imperative shell, Storybook as the game editor. Plus game-bible-tidy, which audits a drifted game repo and fixes it without changing how it plays
